# gq

> One set of map styles for QGIS field projects, report figures and web
> maps

gq keeps the map styles of New Graph’s QGIS field projects in one
registry and hands them to the other tools a map is drawn with: tmap for
figures in reports and MapLibre GL for web maps. A crossing classed as a
barrier is the same red in the field project, the report and the web
map, so the maps behind fish passage and restoration planning read the
same wherever they are seen. Change a style in the registry and every
map that reads it follows.

![Map of the Bittner Creek watershed near Prince George showing streams,
lakes, roads, railway and PSCIS fish passage assessments coloured by
barrier status, with a legend, scale bar and an inset locating the
watershed in British Columbia](reference/figures/readme-map.png)

*PSCIS fish passage assessments in the Bittner Creek watershed,
classified by barrier status. The crossings, roads and lakes are drawn
straight from the gq registry, and the streams and railway take their
colours from it; the code is in the [Getting
started](https://www.newgraphenvironment.com/gq/articles/gq-intro.html)
article.*

## Installation

``` r

pak::pak("NewGraphEnvironment/gq")
```

gq is under active development and its functions change between releases
(see [NEWS](https://www.newgraphenvironment.com/gq/news/index.html)).
Pin a release for reproducible work:
`pak::pak("NewGraphEnvironment/gq@vX.Y.Z")`.

## Example

Load the registry once, then ask for a layer’s style by name. For tmap,
a style comes back as arguments for
[`do.call()`](https://rdrr.io/r/base/do.call.html):

``` r

library(gq)
reg <- gq_reg_main()

gq_tmap_style(reg, "lake")
#> $fill
#> [1] "#dcecf4"
#>
#> $fill_alpha
#> [1] 0.7
#>
#> $col
#> [1] "#1f78b4"
#>
#> $lwd
#> [1] 0.2

# tm_shape(lakes) + do.call(tm_polygons, gq_tmap_style(reg, "lake"))
```

A classified layer carries a colour for each class, and the same
registry builds a MapLibre GL expression with
[`gq_mapgl_classes()`](https://newgraphenvironment.github.io/gq/reference/gq_mapgl_classes.md):

``` r

gq_tmap_classes(reg, "crossings_pscis_assessment")$values
#>   BARRIER  PASSABLE POTENTIAL   UNKNOWN
#> "#ca3c3c" "#33a02c" "#ff7f00" "#bf2ac4"
```

For QGIS itself,
[`gq_style_qml()`](https://newgraphenvironment.github.io/gq/reference/gq_style_qml.md)
returns the path to the style file QGIS wrote, with nothing lost in
translation. A layer defined in your own registry CSV gets a QML from
[`gq_qgis_style()`](https://newgraphenvironment.github.io/gq/reference/gq_qgis_style.md),
which
[`gq_gpkg_style_write()`](https://newgraphenvironment.github.io/gq/reference/gq_gpkg_style_write.md)
stores in a GeoPackage so the layer opens in QGIS already styled.

## Learn more

- [Getting
  started](https://www.newgraphenvironment.com/gq/articles/gq-intro.html):
  the registry, a tmap map and a MapLibre GL map of Bittner Creek, and
  extracting styles from a QGIS project.
- [Map composition with gq and
  tmap](https://www.newgraphenvironment.com/gq/articles/gq-tmap-composition.html):
  a full report map with basemap, legend, scale bar, logo and keymap,
  for a Neexdzii Kwa subbasin.
- [Web maps with gq and
  mapgl](https://www.newgraphenvironment.com/gq/articles/gq-mapgl-composition.html):
  interactive maps with a layer switch, legends and popups, for the same
  subbasin.
- [Function
  reference](https://www.newgraphenvironment.com/gq/reference/)

## Ecosystem

| Package | Role |
|----|----|
| **gq** | Shared map symbology (this package) |
| [fresh](https://www.newgraphenvironment.com/fresh/) | Stream network modelling engine: segment, classify, cluster, aggregate |
| [link](https://www.newgraphenvironment.com/link/) | Intrinsic habitat models: develop, test and communicate |
| [wet](https://www.newgraphenvironment.com/wet/) | Stream flow and water temperature for BC’s Freshwater Atlas |
| [flooded](https://www.newgraphenvironment.com/flooded/) | Delineate floodplain extents from DEMs and stream networks |
| [drift](https://www.newgraphenvironment.com/drift/) | Track land cover change within floodplains over time |
| [floodplains](https://www.newgraphenvironment.com/floodplains/) | Floodplain and land cover change modelling for BC watershed groups |
| [stac_floodplains_bc](https://www.newgraphenvironment.com/stac_floodplains_bc/) | STAC catalogue of floodplain land cover change in BC, 2017-2023, by watershed group |
| [cd](https://www.newgraphenvironment.com/cd/) | Climate departure analysis from ERA5-Land reanalysis |
| [fly](https://www.newgraphenvironment.com/fly/) | Estimate airphoto footprints and select photos that cover a study area |

## Data and methods it builds on

Most registry styles are extracted from New Graph’s QGIS field project
templates by
[`gq_qgs_extract()`](https://newgraphenvironment.github.io/gq/reference/gq_qgs_extract.md),
which reads the project’s XML; the rest are curated by hand. The bundled
example data comes from the [BC Freshwater
Atlas](https://www2.gov.bc.ca/gov/content/data/geographic-data-services/topographic-data/freshwater)
(streams, lakes and watersheds), the Digital Road Atlas (roads) and the
[BC Data Catalogue](https://catalogue.data.gov.bc.ca/) (railway and
PSCIS assessments), and the Neexdzii Kwa set adds modelled habitat and
crossings from [bcfishpass](https://smnorris.github.io/bcfishpass/).
Watersheds are delineated with
[fwapg](https://smnorris.github.io/fwapg/). The rest of the Bittner
Creek set is fetched over the web, and the Neexdzii Kwa set was queried
from a database built with fwapg and bcfishpass. Basemap tiles are
fetched with [maptiles](https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=maptiles),
and each tile layer carries its provider’s credit for the map.

## Citation

``` r

citation("gq")
```

# Package index

## All functions

- [`bittner_lakes`](https://newgraphenvironment.github.io/gq/reference/bittner_lakes.md)
  : Bittner Creek lakes
- [`bittner_pscis`](https://newgraphenvironment.github.io/gq/reference/bittner_pscis.md)
  : Bittner Creek PSCIS assessments
- [`bittner_railway`](https://newgraphenvironment.github.io/gq/reference/bittner_railway.md)
  : Bittner Creek railway
- [`bittner_roads`](https://newgraphenvironment.github.io/gq/reference/bittner_roads.md)
  : Bittner Creek roads
- [`bittner_streams`](https://newgraphenvironment.github.io/gq/reference/bittner_streams.md)
  : Bittner Creek stream network
- [`bittner_wsd`](https://newgraphenvironment.github.io/gq/reference/bittner_wsd.md)
  : Bittner Creek watershed boundary
- [`gq_basemap_blend()`](https://newgraphenvironment.github.io/gq/reference/gq_basemap_blend.md)
  : Multiply a basemap by a relief layer
- [`gq_basemap_tiles()`](https://newgraphenvironment.github.io/gq/reference/gq_basemap_tiles.md)
  : Fetch basemap tiles for a bounding box
- [`gq_bbox_aspect()`](https://newgraphenvironment.github.io/gq/reference/gq_bbox_aspect.md)
  : Pad a bounding box to a target aspect ratio
- [`gq_bbox_clip()`](https://newgraphenvironment.github.io/gq/reference/gq_bbox_clip.md)
  : Restrict features to a bounding box, returning NULL when nothing is
  left
- [`gq_form_types()`](https://newgraphenvironment.github.io/gq/reference/gq_form_types.md)
  : The roster of Mergin survey forms
- [`gq_gpkg_style_write()`](https://newgraphenvironment.github.io/gq/reference/gq_gpkg_style_write.md)
  : Store QGIS styles for a layer in a GeoPackage
- [`gq_group_layers()`](https://newgraphenvironment.github.io/gq/reference/gq_group_layers.md)
  : Get layers in a group
- [`gq_groups()`](https://newgraphenvironment.github.io/gq/reference/gq_groups.md)
  : List all layer groups
- [`gq_mapgl_basemap()`](https://newgraphenvironment.github.io/gq/reference/gq_mapgl_basemap.md)
  : Start a MapLibre GL map on a named basemap, fitted to the data
- [`gq_mapgl_classes()`](https://newgraphenvironment.github.io/gq/reference/gq_mapgl_classes.md)
  : Get a MapLibre match expression for a classified layer
- [`gq_mapgl_controls()`](https://newgraphenvironment.github.io/gq/reference/gq_mapgl_controls.md)
  : Add navigation, a scale bar and a layer switch to a MapLibre GL map
- [`gq_mapgl_layer()`](https://newgraphenvironment.github.io/gq/reference/gq_mapgl_layer.md)
  : Add a styled layer and its legend to a MapLibre GL map
- [`gq_mapgl_network()`](https://newgraphenvironment.github.io/gq/reference/gq_mapgl_network.md)
  : Add water and a stream network to a MapLibre GL map, styled from the
  registry
- [`gq_mapgl_popup()`](https://newgraphenvironment.github.io/gq/reference/gq_mapgl_popup.md)
  : Build a popup for a MapLibre GL layer from column names
- [`gq_mapgl_style()`](https://newgraphenvironment.github.io/gq/reference/gq_mapgl_style.md)
  : Translate a registry layer style to mapgl arguments
- [`gq_qgis_style()`](https://newgraphenvironment.github.io/gq/reference/gq_qgis_style.md)
  : Translate a registry layer style to a QGIS QML document
- [`gq_qgs_extract()`](https://newgraphenvironment.github.io/gq/reference/gq_qgs_extract.md)
  : Extract layer styles from a QGIS project file
- [`gq_reg_custom()`](https://newgraphenvironment.github.io/gq/reference/gq_reg_custom.md)
  : Read a gq custom style registry
- [`gq_reg_main()`](https://newgraphenvironment.github.io/gq/reference/gq_reg_main.md)
  : Load the main gq style registry
- [`gq_reg_merge()`](https://newgraphenvironment.github.io/gq/reference/gq_reg_merge.md)
  : Merge multiple gq registries
- [`gq_reg_read()`](https://newgraphenvironment.github.io/gq/reference/gq_reg_read.md)
  : Read a gq style registry from JSON (alias)
- [`gq_registry_read()`](https://newgraphenvironment.github.io/gq/reference/gq_registry_read.md)
  : Read a gq style registry from JSON
- [`gq_scale_breaks()`](https://newgraphenvironment.github.io/gq/reference/gq_scale_breaks.md)
  : Scale bar breaks appropriate to a map extent
- [`gq_style()`](https://newgraphenvironment.github.io/gq/reference/gq_style.md)
  : Get backend-agnostic style for a registry layer
- [`gq_style_qml()`](https://newgraphenvironment.github.io/gq/reference/gq_style_qml.md)
  : Get the QGIS-native QML style for a layer
- [`gq_symbol_fillable()`](https://newgraphenvironment.github.io/gq/reference/gq_symbol_fillable.md)
  : Does a registry shape accept a fill colour?
- [`gq_symbol_shape()`](https://newgraphenvironment.github.io/gq/reference/gq_symbol_shape.md)
  : Translate a registry symbol shape to a rendering target
- [`gq_symbol_size()`](https://newgraphenvironment.github.io/gq/reference/gq_symbol_size.md)
  : Convert a registry symbol size to a rendering target's units
- [`gq_template_groups()`](https://newgraphenvironment.github.io/gq/reference/gq_template_groups.md)
  : Get groups in a template
- [`gq_template_layers()`](https://newgraphenvironment.github.io/gq/reference/gq_template_layers.md)
  : Resolve template to layers
- [`gq_templates()`](https://newgraphenvironment.github.io/gq/reference/gq_templates.md)
  : List all project templates
- [`gq_theme_layers()`](https://newgraphenvironment.github.io/gq/reference/gq_theme_layers.md)
  : Get layer visibility for a theme
- [`gq_themes()`](https://newgraphenvironment.github.io/gq/reference/gq_themes.md)
  : List all visibility themes
- [`gq_tmap_classes()`](https://newgraphenvironment.github.io/gq/reference/gq_tmap_classes.md)
  : Get classification info for tmap scale functions
- [`gq_tmap_keymap()`](https://newgraphenvironment.github.io/gq/reference/gq_tmap_keymap.md)
  : Build an overview keymap and the viewport to place it in
- [`gq_tmap_legend()`](https://newgraphenvironment.github.io/gq/reference/gq_tmap_legend.md)
  : Build tmap legend arguments from registry layers
- [`gq_tmap_style()`](https://newgraphenvironment.github.io/gq/reference/gq_tmap_style.md)
  : Translate a registry layer style to tmap v4 arguments
- [`neexdzii_bc`](https://newgraphenvironment.github.io/gq/reference/neexdzii_bc.md)
  : British Columbia boundary (simplified)
- [`neexdzii_crossings`](https://newgraphenvironment.github.io/gq/reference/neexdzii_crossings.md)
  : Neexdzii Kwa crossings
- [`neexdzii_falls`](https://newgraphenvironment.github.io/gq/reference/neexdzii_falls.md)
  : Neexdzii Kwa falls
- [`neexdzii_fish_obs`](https://newgraphenvironment.github.io/gq/reference/neexdzii_fish_obs.md)
  : Neexdzii Kwa fish observations
- [`neexdzii_habitat`](https://newgraphenvironment.github.io/gq/reference/neexdzii_habitat.md)
  : Neexdzii Kwa salmon habitat
- [`neexdzii_lakes`](https://newgraphenvironment.github.io/gq/reference/neexdzii_lakes.md)
  : Neexdzii Kwa lakes
- [`neexdzii_railway`](https://newgraphenvironment.github.io/gq/reference/neexdzii_railway.md)
  : Neexdzii Kwa railway
- [`neexdzii_roads`](https://newgraphenvironment.github.io/gq/reference/neexdzii_roads.md)
  : Neexdzii Kwa roads
- [`neexdzii_streams`](https://newgraphenvironment.github.io/gq/reference/neexdzii_streams.md)
  : Neexdzii Kwa stream network
- [`neexdzii_wetlands`](https://newgraphenvironment.github.io/gq/reference/neexdzii_wetlands.md)
  : Neexdzii Kwa wetlands
- [`neexdzii_wsd`](https://newgraphenvironment.github.io/gq/reference/neexdzii_wsd.md)
  : Neexdzii Kwa subbasin watershed boundary

  : Bulkley and Morice watershed groups
